messages:
alex: quick flag from canary: 4-bit path returning confidently wrong dates on a finance prompt set. noticed systematic -1 year bias in a subset of queries. filing here for triage. :frowning:

ting: can you paste an example? is it consistent across tokens or only on numeric tokens?

alex: example (sanitized):
```
Q: 'When did Orion Holdings incorporate?'
4bit: 'June 4, 2017'
fp16: 'June 4, 2018'
```
happens across ~28/250 triggered evals. not random typos, full date shifted.

noor: interesting. could be a scale/zero-point mismatch during quant scale table generation. also check whether we used sign-preserve for that profile.

alex: profile used: `cascade-lowbit-2024-11` (pipeline: fp16 -> fp8 -> int8 -> 4bit). sign-preserve flag true, scale_table version v3.

ting: run replay with topk and per-token logits. please include kv_checksums. use small batch so we can inspect head activations.

deploy-bot: replay started (id: replay-20241208-07). artifacts will land under /mnt/replays/replay-20241208-07/. ETA 7m.

noor: another angle: when we collapse fp8->4bit we apply a clipping threshold per-layer. if threshold too tight, some tokens could systematically bias high/low. compare layer clip histograms.

alex: launching histogram dump job. cmd:
```
quant-dump --model=orion-13b --profile=cascade-lowbit-2024-11 --out=/tmp/qdump.jsonl --fields=layer_stats,head_stats,scale_table
```

ting: add a quick A/B on a deterministic seed locally (use the same tokenizer and padding) and diff the final logits to see if shift occurs early (embedding) or late (output head).

noor: If this is a reproducible arithmetic rounding drift, mitigation options: 1) remap scale_table entries for affected layers, 2) enable micro-fp8 path for the problematic heads, 3) relax clip thresholds for that profile.

alex: holding all further canaries for this profile until we get a root cause. @deploy-bot block `cascade-lowbit-2024-11` from rollouts.

deploy-bot: profile `cascade-lowbit-2024-11` blocked for new canaries and slated for audit.

ting: ops checklist proposal:
- collect headwise activation mean/var for fp16 vs 4bit
- collect per-token topk and entropy diffs
- compare quant_scale_table v2 vs v3 diffs (we recently updated encoding)
- bisect layers/heads to find minimal repro set
- shadow remap candidate and measure regression on same eval set
- communicate to affected CSMs with a non-technical summary

noor: I'll start the histograms and send partial dumps to /mnt/replays/replay-20241208-07/histograms.tar.gz

alex: thanks. initial histogram shows outsized mean shift in heads 2, 14, 21 and layer 23 shows narrower dynamic range after quant. saving full dump.

ting: great narrow down. run targeted bisect on heads [2,14,21]. if bisect shows those heads sufficient, try scale_table remap focusing on those heads (one-off overrides) and shadow test.

noor: parallel follow-up: add a regression test to the quant profile CI that runs a small date/factual prompt set and asserts mean token offset < 0.1 tokens between fp16 and lowbit. ticketing that now.

alex: created tickets: ML-12345 (per-head-date-regression-test), OPS-9876 (hotpatch-scale-remap). linking them to this thread.

opsbot: replay job completed (id: replay-20241208-07). artifacts: /mnt/replays/replay-20241208-07/.

ting: nice. next steps: bisect tomorrow morning (I'll take). noor please prepare remap script template. alex keep holding the canary. will update thread with bisect results.

alex: good plan — thanks all.
